objective: Frozen computation: bond distance on every six-knot tree under every law assignment and on random seven-knot trees; bond distance against tau, delta and delta_K on rings of knots and mixed cycles.
status: Supported 2026-11-18 (referee pending; 7 of 7 predictions held): bond distance = steps apart + 1 on all 94,848 pairs of every six-knot tree under every law assignment and all 8,400 pairs of 80 random seven-knot trees; mixed cycles read at one knot with delta_K = k and delta about 1; rings as predicted (not-all-equal and alternating: steps apart + 1; parity: = delta); tau departs from bond distance on every not-all-equal ring; no bond holds the ends of clause chains.
title: Freedom against correlation
